name: DecreaseVariable
label: Decrease Variable
description: Decreases a numeric variable by a specified value.

fields.name: VariableToDecrease
fields.label: Variable To Decrease
fields.description: The numeric variable that will be decreased.

fields.name: ValueToSubtract
fields.label: Value To Subtract
fields.description: The amount to subtract from the variable. Can be a number or another variable containing a number.

fields.name: DecreasedVariable
fields.label: Decreased Variable
fields.description: Returns the resulting value after decreasing the variable.
